audit.whatIsWrong: The content-layer level chart gives Mel 7/7 stages while Lux wins 53.85% over 1547 games, and the full layer already reads 'Skill' on all seven rows. The page renders two different answers to every stage.
audit.why: Lux out-ranges Mel on every spell (Q 1175 / W 1150 / E 1100 vs Radiant Volley 950 / Solar Snare 1000). Rebuttal is a real counter but it is a 250-range self-cast on a 38s-to-26s cooldown, so it gates timing, not the whole lane. A 53.85% win rate with a skill-expressive gate is 'Skill', not a 7/7 sweep.
audit.corrected: All seven content win[] rows moved to Skill to match the full-layer phases[].side, with whys[] rewritten to state the range gap and the Rebuttal timer instead of a flat loss.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text framed level 6 and first item as Mel's, contradicting the corrected chart; mid/late prose said Lux is 'reduced to waiting'.
audit.why: Final Spark at 3340 range and 60/50/40 cooldown is a lane-decider once Rebuttal (26s at rank 5) is spent. Mel's Golden Eclipse is 120/100/80 and scales off Overwhelm stacks she has to build first.
audit.corrected: mid/late reframed around burning Rebuttal with an auto or E tick and firing into its 26-second gap; whys[4] and whys[5] restated as conditional, not lost.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were named but never stated mechanically: Rebuttal reflecting Light Binding roots Lux herself, Mel's passive loads bonus projectiles on her NEXT attack (the wind-up is the tell), and Rebuttal creating terrain can cut a dashless Lux's retreat.
audit.why: All three come from missingInteractions for this exact matchup plus Riot's own text ('reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker'; 'gains three bonus projectiles on her next attack'; W flags terrain).
audit.corrected: tradeBad now states the reflected root; dosFull[1].d now teaches the auto wind-up as the shield cue; breakdown.cooldowns now carries the real 38s/26s, 6s and 11s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 and 26s at rank 5; Radiant Volley falls to 6s at rank 5; Solar Snare is 11s at rank 1. Those numbers are what make 'commit on its cooldown' actionable.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with all three real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two bullets were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED), and eleven fields called Mel 'he/his/him'.

audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed throughout; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their titles with Mel-specific mechanics.
